title: Help for Artiste and Arts Groups during COVID-19 Pandemic
what_it_is: Help for Artiste and Arts Groups during COVID-19 Pandemic

sections.label: Solidarity Budget arts breakdown
sections.summary: Asked whether the Ministry can provide a breakdown of how the $55 million Solidarity Budget is used for artiste and arts group relief and recovery.

sentences.speaker: Mr Terence Ho Wee San
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth whether the Ministry can provide a breakdown on how the Solidarity Budget of $55 million is to be used in the relief and recovery measures for artiste and arts groups.

sections.label: Arts and Culture Resilience Package
sections.summary: The $55 million ACRP announced by Minister Grace Fu on 7 April 2020 supports the arts and culture community until the end of the year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The $55 million Arts and Culture Resilience Package (ACRP) announced by Minister Grace Fu on 7 April 2020 will provide additional support to the arts and culture community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The ACRP seeks to protect the arts and culture ecosystem and will provide support and opportunities for our cultural organisations and practitioners until the end of the year, while encouraging the development of longer term capabilities that will help the community emerge stronger after COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: For example, the Capability Development Scheme for the Arts (CDSA) supports training programmes until 31 December 2020.

sections.label: Digitalisation Fund and #SGCultureAnywhere
sections.summary: Eight commissions are lined up under #SGCultureAnywhere, 62 projects supported since 14 April 2020, and the Digitalisation Fund aims for over 1,000 opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: To date, eight commissions with key partners such as Lianhe Zaobao, Hear65 and VIDDSEE have been lined up in the coming months under the #SGCultureAnywhere campaign.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Since applications opened on 14 April 2020, 62 projects have been supported.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Overall, the Digitalisation Fund aims to generate over 1,000 opportunities for cultural and related practitioners, including in the post-Circuit Breaker period.

sections.label: CDSA training programmes supported
sections.summary: Since the CDSA opened on 16 March 2020, 163 training programmes have been supported.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Since the CDSA opened on 16 March 2020, 163 training programmes have been supported.
